segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi, yeah, this is Dana from Northline Foods. I'm calling about invoice 18472 for August. It shows 42 seats at $28, but we dropped to 38 seats on July 15.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure, I can look that up. Can you confirm the account email or the billing contact on file?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: It's ap@northlinefoods.com, and the billing contact is me, Dana Price.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks. Okay, I have the account. I see the plan change request on ticket 69314, effective July 15. The billing tool still picked up 42 seats for the full month, so you're right, that's off.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. We just need the corrected amount before our AP close on Friday.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yep, understood. The overage is 4 seats for half the month, so the credit is $56. I'll issue a credit memo against invoice 18472 and send the updated balance to ap@northlinefoods.com.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Does the portal show the new total right away?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: It should update within about 20 minutes. After we hang up, I'll retype the call notes into the ticketing system, copy the invoice and credit details into the billing tool, and finish the adjustment paperwork.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Can you include ticket 69314 in the email so my controller can match it?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Absolutely. You'll get the email today, and the revised amount due will be $1,008. Anything else on this account?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, that's it. Thanks for the quick help.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You're welcome, Dana. Have a good one.
